title: Public Code and Inspectable Engineering Signal
summary: Public-safe index of code and repository surfaces a visitor can inspect without relying on private systems, internal project names, confidential metrics, screenshots, logs, or employer architecture.

entries.label: GitHub profile
entries.whatToInspect: Repository names, README posture, commit activity, implementation examples, experiments, and public engineering artifacts.
entries.publicSafeUse: Use as a public code signal connected to Ravikanth's Operational Intelligence, AI operations, automation, and architecture work.
entries.proofBoundary: Do not infer private employer implementation details, production metrics, customer systems, or confidential architecture from public repository presence.

entries.label: Sentinalai
entries.whatToInspect: Public README, code structure, stated goals, commits, and any public-safe architecture or implementation notes available in the repository.
entries.publicSafeUse: Treat as inspectable public evidence for the Sentinel AI workstream and its relationship to AI-native operations, governed agents, and Operational Intelligence themes.
entries.proofBoundary: Do not claim production adoption, private deployment details, internal integrations, repository metrics, or code behavior that is not visible in public source.

entries.label: seri.ai public artifacts
entries.whatToInspect: Doctrine, reference architecture, Operations Room, publication pack, evidence pack, Ask trust fixtures, patterns, articles, and project descriptions.
entries.publicSafeUse: Use as the primary public body of work when evaluating Ravikanth's architecture judgment and Operational Intelligence thesis.
entries.proofBoundary: This proves public reasoning quality and artifact discipline; it does not prove private production outcomes unless separately supported by approved public evidence.
